**Established conditions** ([[reaction-ord-sonogashira-1]], [[reaction-ord-sonogashira-2]], [[reaction-uspto-sonogashira-1]], [[reaction-uspto-sonogashira-2]]):

2. Add phenylacetylene (after ~5 min)
3. Add CuI (after ~10 min)
4. Hold at 60 °C
5. Wash with brine using triethylamine/THF extraction
6. Filter through Celite and concentrate in vacuo
